texts.content: {"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 6], "size": 5.2, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.08000000000000002}]}], "text": "你先去接孩子"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 8], "size": 5.2, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.08000000000000002}]}], "text": "到家给我发个消息"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 6], "size": 5.2, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.08000000000000002}]}], "text": "秀秀智能轮椅"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 9], "size": 5.2, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.08000000000000002}]}], "text": "一个人也能轻松出门"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 8], "size": 5.2, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.08000000000000002}]}], "text": "你这儿怎么进去啊"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 6], "size": 5.2, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.08000000000000002}]}], "text": "这坡我上不了"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 7], "size": 5.2, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.08000000000000002}]}], "text": "这条消息你发的"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 7], "size": 5.2, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.08000000000000002}]}], "text": "刚才进店时发的"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 7], "size": 5.2, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.08000000000000002}]}], "text": "她的轮椅上不来"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 6], "size": 5.2, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.08000000000000002}]}], "text": "得把台阶写上"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 9], "size": 5.2, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.08000000000000002}]}], "text": "这两处可以报给街道"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 6], "size": 5.2, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.08000000000000002}]}], "text": "看看能不能修"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 7], "size": 5.2, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.08000000000000002}]}], "text": "样布先拿出来吧"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 8], "size": 5.2, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.08000000000000002}]}], "text": "我店里好像有把尺"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 8], "size": 5.2, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.08000000000000002}]}], "text": "这两根柱子挪一下"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 8], "size": 5.2, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.08000000000000002}]}], "text": "去车站就不用绕了"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 6], "size": 5.2, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.08000000000000002}]}], "text": "这里转不过来"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 7], "size": 5.2, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.08000000000000002}]}], "text": "今天不用接孩子"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 6], "size": 4.5, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.08000000000000002}]}], "text": "两年后的春天"}
